title: Fish Curry
description: Fish Curry is a comforting Indian-style curry featuring tender white fish simmered in a fragrant masala and creamy coconut milk base. Mustard oil, Kashmiri chili, coriander, cumin, and aromatic spices create a rich, balanced gravy that pairs beautifully with rice or Indian breads.

ingredients.title: For the Fish Marinade
items: Firm white fish fillets – 500 g, such as kingfish, cod, or tilapia, cut into 4 cm pieces
Kashmiri red chili powder – ½ tsp

ingredients.title: For the Curry Base
items: Kashmiri chili powder – 1 tsp, adjust to taste
Coconut milk – 200 ml, full-fat, or 150 ml coconut cream + 50 ml water

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinating the Fish
steps: Place the fish pieces in a bowl.
Add turmeric powder, Kashmiri chili powder, salt, and lemon juice.
Mix gently to coat the fish evenly.
Set aside for at least 10 minutes while preparing the curry base.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Curry Base
steps: Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan until it just begins to smoke, then reduce the heat to medium.
Add fenugreek seeds, if using, and sauté for 10–15 seconds until fragrant.
Add chopped onions and cook slowly for 8–10 minutes until golden brown.
Add ginger paste and garlic paste and fry for about 1 minute until the raw aroma disappears.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 4–5 minutes until they break down and the oil begins to separate from the masala.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Infusing the Spices
steps: Stir in turmeric powder, Kashmiri chili powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder.
Cook the spices for 30–40 seconds to bloom their flavors.
Add slit green chilies, if using, and stir briefly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Forming the Curry
steps: Pour in the coconut milk and fish stock or water.
Stir well and bring the curry to a gentle simmer.
Season with salt and adjust the consistency with additional water if needed.
Simmer for 4–5 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Cooking the Fish
steps: Gently slide the marinated fish pieces into the simmering curry.
Cook over low heat for 5–6 minutes until the fish is just cooked through and tender.
Turn the fish only once during cooking to prevent it from breaking apart.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Finishing the Curry
steps: Turn off the heat and stir in the juice of ½ lemon.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves.
Let the curry rest for 2–3 minutes before serving so the flavors can settle.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with steamed basmati rice.
Pair with jeera rice for an aromatic rice-based meal.
Serve with naan or paratha for a hearty Indian bread pairing.

chefTips: Cook the curry base until oil rises to the surface; this is an important sign that the masala has cooked properly.
Use Kashmiri chili powder for vibrant color without excessive heat.
Avoid overcooking the fish; it should be flaky, tender, and moist.
For extra depth of flavor, briefly pan-sear the marinated fish before adding it to the curry.
Heat mustard oil until it just begins to smoke before reducing the heat to mellow its pungency.
